_readme: Control centre › Systems reads this file. Keep it up to date whenever a system changes stage. Plain words – the owners read it. ‘All systems’ shows what is RUNNING (live, test, broken, off); ‘Planned’ shows what isn't running yet (build, planned, parked). status: live = guests/staff use it now · test = running, still being checked · build = being built · planned = decided, not started · parked = idea on the shelf · off = switched off/retired · broken = should work but doesn't.

items.name: Round2 website (game menu)
items.what: The game-style homepage shown on www.round2.sg.

items.name: Website visitor stats
items.what: Counts what visitors tap (numbers only) for the Website tab here.

items.name: New booking page
items.what: Guests pick a room, time and length, pay with HitPay, and it goes straight into SimplyBook. Pays live once the live HitPay key is in Cloudflare; the Test bench always uses the HitPay sandbox. Safe mode (Systems › Switches) shows the old SimplyBook calendar instead.
items.runs: round2sg-home/slots (GitHub Pages) + booking engine · opened from the website’s Book screen

items.name: Booking engine (Cloudflare)
items.what: The fast back end: free slots, 10-min holds, HitPay, putting bookings in SimplyBook, TV message timer, menu payments.

items.name: SimplyBook booking page
items.what: The calendar behind everything, and the safe-mode fallback (Systems › Switches shows it on the booking page). Walk-in, WhatsApp and staff bookings still go in here.

items.name: SimplyBook phone alerts
items.what: Push alerts in the SimplyBook app stopped on every phone on 29 Oct, 5:50pm – also for bookings on SimplyBook's own page. Logging out/in didn't help. Ask SimplyBook support.

items.name: Mirror rooms (Atlas ↔ Vale blocks)
items.what: Tested 30 Oct after SimplyBook's callback moved to the engine: works. When Atlas or Vale is booked (online or by staff), blocks the other room at the same time; moves and cancels follow. Only for the Early bird / Off-peak / Peak services. If the twin room can't take the block (already taken, or outside SimplyBook's hours, e.g. late-night), nothing is blocked and nobody is told.
items.runs: SimplyBook callback → booking engine (/sb/notify) → Make: [BACKEND] SYSTEM BLOCKS MIRROR ROOMS

items.name: Mirror rooms in the engine (+ alert if a block fails)
items.what: To do: move the Atlas ↔ Vale blocking from Make into the Cloudflare engine. No Make operations, and staff get a Telegram alert when a block can't be made (twin room taken, late-night past SimplyBook's hours, or a service that isn't mirrored). Best done together with the staff booking alerts.
items.runs: Booking engine (Cloudflare) – replaces Make: [BACKEND] SYSTEM BLOCKS MIRROR ROOMS

items.name: Confirmation email link (TV message)
items.what: A line in SimplyBook's confirmation email that opens the guest's booking page. Needs the booking-code variable added to the email template.

items.name: Staff booking alerts (Telegram)
items.what: A separate 'Round2 Bookings' bot + staff group gets every booking and cancellation. Never the Madd Pizza group.

items.name: Online rescheduling
items.what: Rules decided in part (3 h cut-off, $15 then $35). WhatsApp only until switched on.

items.name: Round2 addresses for guest links (round2.sg)
items.what: Since 31 Oct guests see round2.sg addresses, not 'donttelldadyet': booking confirmation after paying and 'View your booking' → book.round2.sg (/done, /find, /b/<code>); room food menu → menu.round2.sg/<room> (e.g. menu.round2.sg/vale). TV message links were already cue.round2.sg. DNS stays in Wix (CNAME book / menu → donttelldadyet-prog.github.io); domain registered at Vodien. Old links still work. Still to do: owner points each room's Wix links page (valelinks etc.) at menu.round2.sg/<room>; the SimplyBook confirmation-email line should use book.round2.sg/b/<code>.
items.runs: GitHub Pages repos round2-book and round2-menu (DNS in Wix) · booking engine PUBLIC_BOOK / PUBLIC_MENU
items.code: round2sg-home · HANDOFF.md (TO DO at the top)

items.name: Room food menu (QR on the TV)
items.what: Guests order food from their room and pay with HitPay (live once the live key is in). Test an order: skip HitPay or the full HitPay-sandbox flow. Waiting for Madd Pizza's PayNow confirmation. The $0.50 test item only shows in Test an order; real guests can't buy it. To do before launch: kitchen opening/closing hours, and items that stop after the main kitchen closes (owner getting the times from Madd); per-room QR codes.

items.name: Kitchen Telegram slip
items.what: Paid orders post to the Madd Pizza kitchen group with a 'food is at the pickup point' button.

items.name: Order record, Drive slip, accounts sheet
items.what: Saves each paid order, writes the print slip to Google Drive and adds the row to the accounts sheet.

items.name: Kitchen printing
items.what: An Android phone syncs the Drive folder and a printing app prints each slip. Works but basic – ideas on the shelf.

items.name: Madd nightly settlement
items.what: Totals the day's Madd payable at 11pm.

items.name: Madd payout (Telegram buttons)
items.what: Telegram buttons to mark Madd as paid.

items.name: Automatic payout to Madd Pizza
items.what: Next project. Nightly/weekly total → owner gets Approve/Skip on Telegram → HitPay pays Madd's saved bank account/PayNow from the HitPay wallet → confirmation in the shared Madd + Round2 group with a 'Received and tallied' button for Madd's manager. Needs HitPay to switch on Payouts and Madd's bank details or UEN.

items.name: Old Wix food orders
items.what: The old Wix checkout. The Make scenario is still switched on but gets no orders.

items.name: Food menu off Make (hybrid)
items.what: Next: test orders and the 'Loot dropped' ack → Telegram move into the engine. The accounts-sheet row and the Drive print file stay on Make. Saves Make operations.

items.name: Round2 Home (Android/Google TV)
items.what: The home screen on Kai (TCL), Kaeden and Maximillion (Sony) and Atlas (Prism+).
items.runs: Android app, updates from GitHub releases

items.name: Round2 Home (LG)
items.what: The same menu on Scarlett, Vale and Bella (rooted LG).

items.name: AirPlay on Bella's LG
items.what: A custom AirPlay receiver, because Bella's TV can't get LG's own.

items.name: Themes, event backgrounds, sounds
items.what: Backgrounds and sounds per room and for events, from the Themes tab.

items.name: Round2 messages to TVs
items.what: Birthday, '10 minutes left', 'that's a wrap' etc. from TV messages › Round2 messages. Each message is tagged by who made it: gold ROUND2 (by hand, +1h, Late session), blue ⚙ AUTO WRAP-UP, grey GUEST. Messages 12am–6am count as the night before.

items.name: Guest messages (cue.round2.sg)
items.what: Guests write their own TV message from a link; staff approve; it pops up on time. Each link is tied to its booking or note when made (moved → moves, deleted → cancelled); a link made first waits and ties itself, Late session ties it straight away, Pair fixes a wrong time, and a phone heads-up comes 3 h before if it's still not tied (2 Nov).
items.runs: cue.round2.sg + booking engine /gm (messages kept in the engine since 1 Nov; Make scenario off, kept as fallback)

items.name: Message timer
items.what: Sends each queued message to its TV a minute before its time.
items.runs: Booking engine (replaced Make's GUEST MESSAGE TIMER, now off)

items.name: Messages follow their booking
items.what: When staff move a booking in SimplyBook (new time, day or room), its guest message moves too; if the booking is cancelled, the message is cancelled. Happens the moment SimplyBook reports the change (and is checked again right before the message shows). Moving a message by hand still works and isn't undone.

items.name: In session: extend a session (+1/+2/+3h)
items.what: Control centre › In session shows today's bookings and notes per room – after 5pm also tonight's after-midnight sessions. +1h/+2h/+3h: a booking or ordinary note gets ONE EXT note after it ('EXT till 1am · Amanda'), stretched on each +1h; a Late session note is stretched itself and its text changed ('late till 2am'). Vale/Atlas: the twin gets a SYSTEM BLOCK. Moves or adds 'About 10 minutes to go' / 'That's a wrap!', TV shows '+N CREDITS ADDED'. Undo for 30 min.

items.name: Late session
items.what: In session › Late session, or its own Home Screen button (staff.round2.sg/late/). Key in a WhatsApp or walk-in session, also past midnight, in 15-min steps: one SimplyBook note with name and pax, clash check first, optional wrap-up messages (untick = none, Auto wrap-up skips it too). TESTING (owner, 2 Nov): the form asks for “Night of” + arrival (times after 12am show their real date, a red box confirms it; before 7am the page opens on last night). Waiting for the admin's feedback: keep “Night of”, or pick the real date instead?

items.name: Upcoming late sessions (change / cancel)
items.what: Under Late session: every note-session after midnight or running past it, 45 days ahead. Change (time, night, room) or Cancel (tap twice) – the note, its TV messages and its SimplyBook label follow. Real bookings are changed in SimplyBook.

items.name: After-midnight labels in SimplyBook
items.what: SimplyBook only shows 11am–12am. A session starting after 12am gets '↓ AFTER 12AM · name · times' at 11:30pm the night before; one running past 12am gets '↓ TILL 1AM · name'. Labels block nothing and nothing reads them; they follow every change.
items.runs: Booking engine (every 30 min + on each change)

items.name: Auto wrap-up
items.what: Switch in TV messages › Auto wrap-up (on since 2 Nov). Every session today gets 'About 10 minutes to go' and 'That's a wrap!' by itself, kept in step with new bookings, extensions, moves and cancellations; uses messages already set by hand instead of doubling; one session can be switched off. Switching off removes everything it scheduled; hand-made ones stay.
items.runs: Booking engine – as Round2 messages (blue ⚙ tag)

items.name: Clean-up of orphan wrap-up messages
items.what: Every 10 min and when SimplyBook reports a change: a '10 minutes to go' / 'That's a wrap!' whose booking or note no longer exists is cancelled (max 4 at once, as a safety stop).

items.name: Food alerts on the TV
items.what: 'Order locked in' and 'Loot dropped' on the room's TV.

items.name: TV tiles say what's on screen
items.what: Round2 messages › On the TVs now shows what each TV has in front (PS4, YouTube, Round2 menu…) and for how long. Built 2 Nov (TV app 1.0.225); each TV shows it once it's updated. Same update fixes LG TVs reporting the wrong message as 'shown'.
items.runs: LG helper + Android app check-ins → control centre

items.name: Remote TV updates (Update now from the control centre)
items.what: Built 2 Nov (TV app 1.0.226; works on a TV once it has 1.0.226). Update now on each TV tile (Round2 messages › On the TVs now), refused while the TV is off, locked in its Staff tools, or its room has a session now or within 10 min. LG installs by itself (download + SHA-256 check first, 'don't switch off' notice, progress on the tile, reinstalls itself on start-up if cut off). Android only gets it ready – staff press Install in Staff tools › Update app.
items.runs: Engine (tvupdate) + LG helper / Android app (cmd, update in Firebase)
items.code: round2sg-home worker (tvUpdate) · round2-tv-launcher webos/service/round2d.sh, app/…/FoodAlerts.java, manager/index.html

items.name: Control centre
items.what: staff.round2.sg – this page (Home Screen app, locked until the keys are pasted): sessions, messages, themes, menu, website stats, systems and tests.

items.name: Staff phone alerts (push)
items.what: Alerts tab: new / changed / cancelled bookings and a 1-hour reminder (bookings and notes) on this phone, with the room's character icon. Needs the app opened from the Home Screen (iOS 16.4+).

items.name: One staff code for TV setup
items.what: TV setup (Events, Rooms, Sounds, TV settings) asks for a GitHub key today. Replace it with one constant code through the engine, like every other tab.

items.name: Round2 vs Guest messages – review
items.what: After a few days of use: do the two message lists still feel awkward? (Since 2 Nov: separate lists, colour tags, night-based dates.)

items.name: New TV messages key
items.what: Swap the Firebase TV messages key for a new one (security tidy-up, not urgent).

items.name: Staff roll-out
items.what: Give staff the control centre (Home Screen app + keys) once the owners are happy everything is stable.
